rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. PP03 flagged four rows as source-period facts earlier than the 2024-06-30 report date. Raw source shows these same revolving loans in the current-period SOI block with 2024 coupons (ADMA table 21 row 36 at 9.08%, CPIG table 12 row 38 at 10.15%, Hills table 21 row 3 at 9.83%, Paragon table 11 row 28 at 9.30%) and separately in the comparative SOI block with prior-period coupon/reference combinations cited above. Retaining the comparative rows under report_date 2024-06-30 is therefore a real comparative-period leak, not a false alarm.
